question: Should #54397 remain the broad topic/session management umbrella after the current Web UI/session-thread work, or should the remaining CLI, TUI, metadata, import/export, and topic-family slices be split into narrower canonical issues?
rationale: The remaining behavior is product and data-model scope across multiple clients and persistent session contracts, so automation should not choose the permanent scope or merge shape.

options.title: Keep Umbrella, Route Narrow Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella while routing implementation through linked narrower issues or PRs for each accepted slice.

options.title: Split Then Close
options.body: Designate separate canonical issues for CLI lifecycle, TUI management, topic metadata, import/export, and topic-family semantics, then close this umbrella once those links preserve the remaining scope.

options.title: Declare Current Scope Enough
options.body: Treat the current Web UI/sidebar/picker thread management plus chat naming as sufficient and explicitly leave the rest out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella, Route Narrow Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella while routing implementation through linked narrower issues or PRs for each accepted slice.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent merged session-thread and grouping work that defines the current foundation.
